description: asdlc: lint a document as soon as Claude writes it, and guard a branch before Claude pushes it

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'asdlc: uv is not installed, so the guard did not run. Install uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/' >&2; exit 1; }; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/asdlc" hook run guard; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; then echo 'asdlc: uv could not start the guard (often no network to fetch Python 3.15 or its packages), so it did not run' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'asdlc: uv is not installed, so the guard did not run. Install uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/' >&2; exit 1; }; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/asdlc" hook run guard; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; then echo 'asdlc: uv could not start the guard (often no network to fetch Python 3.15 or its packages), so it did not run' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit "$status"

command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'asdlc: uv is not installed, so the linter did not run. Install uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/' >&2; exit 1; }; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/asdlc" hook run lint; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; then echo 'asdlc: uv could not start the linter (often no network to fetch Python 3.15 or its packages), so it did not run' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit "$status"
